WITH recent AS (
    SELECT b.id AS booking_id,
           b.passenger_id,
           b.created_at,
           count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY b.passenger_id) AS bookings_by_passenger,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'cancelled')
               OVER (PARTITION BY b.passenger_id)      AS cancelled_by_passenger
    FROM bookings b
    WHERE b.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
      AND b.fraud_checked = false
)
SELECT booking_id, passenger_id,
       bookings_by_passenger,
       cancelled_by_passenger,
       (CASE WHEN bookings_by_passenger >= 5 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN cancelled_by_passenger >= 3 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN bookings_by_passenger >= 3
              AND cancelled_by_passenger >= 2 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END) AS fraud_score
FROM recent;

WITH flagged AS (

    SELECT {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.booking_id }},

           '{"bookings_24h": {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.bookings_by_passenger }}, "cancels_24h": {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.cancelled_by_passenger }}}'::jsonb,
           'n8n_fraud_job',
           false,
           now()
    WHERE {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.fraud_score }} >= 50
    RETURNING id
)
UPDATE bookings SET fraud_checked = true
WHERE id = {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.booking_id }};
